我们的基因组研究设施为整个文明提供了前所未有的生理改造能力。

然而，帝国的公民们想要更多。他们呼吁打破中央化的资源控制，允许所谓的"生物黑客"自由且不受限制地使用基因技术。
texts.en:
Our Genomic Research Facilities have granted our entire civilization access to physiological alteration unlike anything we have ever experienced.

However, the citizens of our empire want more. There are calls for breaking up centralized resources, and allowing so-called "biohackers" free and unrestricted access to gene technology.
